about: LayerNorm input scales of the WeVisOne-VL-2B vision tower at 512x512 (FP16SAFE), as calibrated for the published file on the rows syn_a_det, nasa_jungle_det, nasa_truck_det and a crop of the source package's matting figure: 2 ** max(0, ceil(log2(absmax / 8))) per norm input. All 48 encoder norms are scaled; the adapter keeps scale 1. vision_taps.py uses them when LN_SCALES points at this file.
